g.text: Keep logical overlay, tunnel underlay and physical uplink separate.
No physical eth0, Geneve tunnel, UPLINK or eth1 hop.
logical container addresses stay inside Geneve
DHCP advertises 1.1.1.1 and 1.0.0.1. A lease alone does not prove egress.
prepare the physical uplink before services start
After resume, the gateway MAC may change. OVN ages 172.17.0.1/32
after 30 idle seconds and relearns it with ARP. Tailscale is management only.
